kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أحتشم (form VIII)
# أَحْتَشِمُ (ʔaḥtašimu) /ʔaħ.ta.ʃi.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِحْتَشَمَ (iḥtašama)
# أَحْتَشِمَ (ʔaḥtašima) /ʔaħ.ta.ʃi.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَشَمَ (iḥtašama)
# أَحْتَشِمْ (ʔaḥtašim) /ʔaħ.ta.ʃim/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِحْتَشَمَ (iḥtašama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
